title: Mixing Reagents
prompt: The Alchemist mixes numbers the way he mixes reagents. // divides and throws away the remainder, % keeps ONLY the remainder, and ** raises to a power. Predict each blend.

rounds.explain: // is floor division — it divides and throws the remainder away. 7 // 2 is 3, not 3.5.
% is the remainder, or modulo. 7 split into 2s leaves 1 left over.
